title: Fundamental theorem of calculus for the integrating factor exp(−∫_0^τ g)
statement: Let g: ℝ → ℝ and R ∈ ℝ with g Lebesgue integrable on (0, R], and put F(τ) := exp(−∫_{(0,τ]} g(s)ds). Then τ ↦ −g(τ)F(τ) is integrable on (0, R], and F(t) = F(σ) + ∫_{(σ,t]} (−g(τ)F(τ))dτ for all 0 ≤ σ ≤ t ≤ R.
lean_statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (R : ℝ), IntegrableOn g (Ioc 0 R) → IntegrableOn (fun τ ↦ -(g τ * Real.exp (-∫ s in Ioc 0 τ, g s))) (Ioc 0 R) ∧ ∀ σ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ σ → σ ≤ t → t ≤ R → Real.exp (-∫ s in Ioc 0 t, g s) = Real.exp (-∫ s in Ioc 0 σ, g s) + ∫ τ in Ioc σ t, -(g τ * Real.exp (-∫ s in Ioc 0 τ, g s))
